source_preview:
IT Network Audit & Compliance Executive
“The IT Network Audit & Compliance Executive will be responsible for supporting audit
readiness, compliance and governance activities within the IT Network function. This
role involves preparing audit documentation, identifying risks, evaluating operational
effectiveness and ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements
and industry standards.
Key Responsibilities:
Audit Documentation & Support
Compile and organize documentation for internal, external, ISO, and RBI audits.
Prepare preliminary audit data and perform initial data validation and sanity checks.
Coordinate with auditors and internal teams to provide required information within
defined timelines.
Risk & Control Assessment
Identify potential risks, control gaps, and process deficiencies within the IT Network
function.
Recommend corrective measures to strengthen compliance and operational resilience.
Governance & Compliance Alignment
Evaluate the operational effectiveness of the IT Network Team in alignment with GRC
and Information Security policies.
Ensure adherence to regulatory, compliance, and governance frameworks.
Asset & Documentation Management
Maintain and update the IT Network asset inventory with accuracy and compliance
requirements.
Review, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to
network operations.
Reporting & Tracking

Update and maintain the Branch Health Report on a regular basis.
Track ongoing projects and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
Audit Coordination
Act as a key point of contact during RBI, ISO, and internal audits.
Coordinate audit responses and ensure closure of audit observations in collaboration
with relevant teams.
Stakeholder Collaboration
Work closely with the GRC and Information Security teams to ensure consistent
compliance and control monitoring across IT operations.”
